keyVerseDR: "This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased: hear ye him." (Mt 17:5)

level1.title: Jesus Shines
level1.story: Jesus took Peter, James, and John up a mountain. His face shone like the sun, and His clothes became bright white. A voice said, "This is My beloved Son. Listen to Him!"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you listen to Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me listen to You. Amen.

activity.title: On the mountain
activity.intro: Draw Jesus shining on the mountain.
activity.prompt: Jesus shining like the sun on a high mountain, with Moses, Elijah, and three disciples

level2.title: The Transfiguration
level2.story: Jesus took Peter, James, and John up a high mountain apart. He was transfigured before them, and His face shone like the sun, and His garments became white as snow. Moses and Elijah appeared, talking with Him. Peter said, "Lord, it is good for us to be here." A bright cloud overshadowed them, and a voice said, "This is My beloved Son... hear ye Him."
level2.keyLine: This is my beloved Son: hear ye him.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did Jesus show His glory before the cross?
When have you felt close to God?
level2.prayer: Jesus, let me see Your glory and listen. Amen.

activity.title: Luminous Mysteries
activity.intro: Match each Mystery of Light to what happened.
pairs: The Father speaks at the Jordan

art.mainBrief: Jesus in shining white on mountain top, Moses and Elijah, three apostles bowing
art.heartBrief: Sun rays radiating from heart; cloud at top
